Most sand wedges require complicated adjustments—open your stance way up, open your club face way up, squat way down to lower your hands, swing super steep and very hard, and on and on and on.

The worst part?

Even when you think you nailed all those... the results are still hit or miss.

That’s why a former Nike club designer set out to fix the problem.

The result?

The BX-1 Wedge—the first sand wedge reverse-engineered to work with your natural swing.

No gimmicks, no tricky techniques, just a club that lets you set up square and swing with confidence.

Here’s what makes the BX-1 a revolutionary upgrade for your short game:

✅ Extra-Wide Sole: Glides through sand effortlessly, preventing digging and fat shots.
✅ Beveled Leading Edge: Cuts cleanly for a smooth, consistent swing.
✅ High Bounce & 63° Loft: Lifts the ball high and soft, no matter the lie.

Golfers everywhere are raving about the BX-1:

💬 “The club would enter the sand and just glide through it. It was just 100% different than my personal 60-degree wedge. It would come up higher, land softer, and the results were 100 times better.” – Jeff N.

Imagine stepping into a bunker knowing you’ll get out in one shot, without second-guessing your setup or swing.

With the BX-1 Wedge, that’s exactly what you’ll experience.

And for a limited time, you can get the BX-1 Wedge for $60 off and FREE shipping!
